text:
𝗕𝗥𝗔𝗥 𝟰/𝟯𝟬! 🔥

Gurnoor Brar's career-best 4/30 bowled NZ out for 134, their lowest ODI total v India at home.
India won by 4 runs (DLS) to lead 2-0 👏

#Cricket #INDvNZ

facebook.caption:
𝗕𝗥𝗔𝗥 𝗞𝗔 𝗣𝗔𝗡𝗝𝗔 𝗡𝗔𝗛𝗜𝗡, 𝗣𝗟𝗔𝗬𝗘𝗥 𝗢𝗙 𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗠𝗔𝗧𝗖𝗛! 🔥🇮🇳

👉 Gurnoor Brar ke career-best 4/30, NZ 41 over mein 134 pe all out
👉 Ye NZ ka India ke khilaaf ghar mein sabse kam ODI total hai
👉 Rain ke baad India 113/7 (26 ov) pe, DLS se 4 run se jeet
👉 5 match ki series mein India 2-0 aage

Brar ko kitne number doge? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #INDvNZ #TeamIndia
